title: Asian Para Games 2026: Who Is Himanshu Nandal? Indian Para Swimmer Wins Third Bronze Medal
summary: India's Himanshu Nandal continued his impressive run at the Asian Para Games, completing a hat-trick of bronze medals with another podium finish in the men's 100m freestyle S11 event in Nagoya on Friday. The visually impaired swimmer clocked 1 minute 5.90 seconds to secure third place in the competition.
